💡 Oleylamine enables one-step solvothermal regeneration of spent LiFePO₄, simultaneously reducing Fe³⁺, repairing lattice defects, suppressing Li-Fe antisite disorder, and stabilizing morphology, then forming an N-doped carbon coating. item.title: From Micro to Nano: Boosting γ-MnO2 Cathode Performance through Particle Size Engineering
item.description:

Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Nanosized γ-MnO2 (62 nm) outperforms micron-sized counterparts, delivering 160.1 mAh g–1, 66% capacity at 5C, and 70% retention after 400 cycles. Enhanced capacitive contribution (68.9%) and homogeneous solid-solution intercalation avoid phase-transition bottlenecks. This establishes particle-size engineering as a simple, effective route to fast-charging, long-life MnO2 cathodes.

💡 The novelty lies in a protonated polyaniline-modified MXene/CNT scaffold that immobilizes iodine and accelerates polyiodide conversion while ensuring conductivity. This suppresses the shuttle effect, enabling a high iodine loading of 43.96 wt%, 150 mAh g–1 at 20 C, and 10,000-cycle stability.
